findings.description: Original criticism: All predictions are checked against one fixture-global anonymous-base digest and generation/reweave identity. FrozenImage carries no individual base lineage. A normal multi-image run with distinct caption bases cannot be represented truthfully, and reusing the global digest lets unrelated image records satisfy the provenance check.
findings.evidence: Original source apps/prototype-description-service/scripts/eval_harness/name_binding_eval.py:93-99,113-121,233-237 has global source and no per-image lineage; predictions have no generation/reweave fields. Real producers bind spans to a caption: scene/infrastructure/vlm/florence_local_adapter.py:128-173 searches the supplied caption; scene/infrastructure/vlm/gpu_remote_adapter.py:1049-1061 computes spans then calls span_replaceable; scene/application/identity_merge/merge.py:59-65,119-125,293 verifies exact caption spans. These producers do not currently emit this standalone evaluator contract; no producer adapter is claimed. RED legacy two-image/global-source test observed DID NOT RAISE. Fixed FrozenImage.source at current module:109-116, required prediction lineage at119-129, image-specific comparisons at258-276, image_sources report at298-306. v2 distinct-bases/reused-local-ID positive test and isolated digest/generation/reweave swaps pass; bypass-lineage mutant yields 6 failures. V1 is deliberately refused. findings.description: Original criticism: Missing evidence is silently converted into explicit empty data. Omitting gold_bindings defaults to [] and is indistinguishable from an intentional negative-control annotation. Omitting a prediction bindings field also defaults to [] and is scored as measured all-abstain with complete coverage.
findings.evidence: Original apps/prototype-description-service/scripts/eval_harness/name_binding_eval.py:99,110 defaults both fields with Field(default_factory=list). Both omission RED cases observed DID NOT RAISE. Current module:116,129 requires both lists. Explicit [] remains valid; omitted gold or per-record bindings is refused. Existing missing arm-image records remain partial/no_records, missing_record outcomes, frozen denominators and null rates when no records exist. New negative-control test distinguishes missing prediction (coverage 0, no_records, all_abstain=None) from explicit [] (coverage 1, complete, all_abstain counted). Restoring either empty default independently makes its regression fail. No zero-error PASS or acceptance field is added. Canon CAL-02/CARD-03 https://github.com/darce/heuristics-canon/blob/v0.26.2/reasoning/designed-unknown.md ; CARD-11/Principle15 https://github.com/darce/heuristics-canon/blob/v0.26.2/reasoning/measurement-integrity.md ; Principle18 enforced by the versioned Pydantic contract.

findings.description: Original criticism: The report write is outside the OSError handler and directly truncates the destination. Routine output-path failures escape as raw tracebacks; a mid-write failure destroys a previous complete report.
findings.evidence: Original apps/prototype-description-service/scripts/eval_harness/name_binding_eval.py:150-157 catches only evaluation errors, then calls output.write_text. RED observed raw FileNotFoundError and OSError(simulated-full-disk); prior /tmp report became the first 20 characters. Current module:170-195 validates and serializes before output creation, writes a tempfile.mkstemp sibling, closes its descriptor, writes complete UTF-8 text, calls os.replace, and cleans the temporary path in finally. Output OSError returns 1 with cannot write report. Owner tests cover missing parent, partial writes with and without a prior report, failed replacement, invalid input before any output, preservation of prior bytes and temporary cleanup. Real subprocess CLI also verified successful replacement and missing-parent error. Direct-write mutant causes 3 regression failures. CARD-03 https://github.com/darce/heuristics-canon/blob/v0.26.2/reasoning/designed-unknown.md

Atomic report replacement protects against write/replace failures tested here; it is not a claim of power-loss durability or concurrent-writer arbitration.
